content: Avalanche Warp Messaging (AWM): a network-layer native messaging primitive letting any subnet/L1 send authenticated messages to another subnet without a bridging contract. Message envelope is an AddressedPayload{SourceAddress, DestinationChainID, DestinationAddress, Payload}; DestinationChainID is the txID that created the destination blockchain on the P-Chain (globally unique flat ID, not hierarchical). Validators of the source subnet sign the message (BLS aggregate signature); the destination VM verifies the aggregate signature against the known validator set of the source subnet before acting on the payload -- trust is anchored in the source subnet's own validator set, not a third-party bridge.
